# Dave Klausner 

### Tenure

c. 1996 – c. 2009

 David Klausner is a former Hot Wheels graphic designer who worked at Mattel from at least 1996 to around 2009. He is mentioned a number of times in the Hot Wheels Classics 30-Car Set as graphic designer for the '59 Cadillac Funny Car and '29 Ford Pickup, as well as a fictitious sponsor on older products. He is known to have worked alongside Jerry Thienprasiddhi, Roman Cortez, Steve Vandervate and Mike McClone.
